## PRB1.5. Capacity

-   Estonia registered 0.01 minutes of average en route ATFM delay per flight during 2025, which remained 0.01 after the post-ops adjustment process, thus achieving the local target value of 0.06. Delays in Estonia remained stable year-on-year.

-   The number of ATCOs in OPS is 25 being above the 2025 plan in Tallinn ACC by 1 FTE.

-   The yearly total of sector opening hours in Tallinn ACC was 10,493, showing a 0.22% increase compared to 2024.

-   Tallinn ACC registered 15.90 IFR movements per sector opening hour in 2025, being 4% above the 2024 levels.
